about: Every OBP-API call the cacher, setup-entity and delete-records make, all through internal/obp/client.go: verb, path (OBP placeholders in capitals; ENTITY is one of the entities in internal/cache/cache.go), the source file and the text that makes the call (needles), and the response fields the code reads. The OIDC discovery and token requests go to OBP-OIDC, not OBP-API, and are not listed. internal/obp/contract_test.go checks this list against the source and against snapshot.json, which obp-api-contract/snapshot.py writes from an OBP-API's resource docs.

calls.note: Filtered by a record field and paged with obp_limit/obp_offset. Each record is read from under the entity name when OBP nests it there; delete-records also prints every other *_id field of the record.
